purpose: Define distributable canonical packages as explicit immutable snapshots of selected canonical identities and physical source artifacts, without using archive filenames or paths as semantic identity.

topics.name: Package Identity
topics.purpose: Define distributable canonical packages as explicit immutable snapshots of selected canonical identities and physical source artifacts, without using archive filenames or paths as semantic identity.

semantics.package_rule: Package identity is explicit metadata separate from archive filename.
semantics.membership_rule: Package membership is explicit and traceable to canonical identities/source artifacts.
semantics.snapshot_rule: A package represents a specific assembled snapshot.
semantics.source_rule: Packaging does not change semantic ownership/source roles.
semantics.path_rule: Archive path and filename are storage/distribution details only.
semantics.rebuild_rule: Rebuilding the same semantic package must produce an explicitly comparable package manifest.

invariants.rule: Packaging, hashing, certification and repository distribution preserve canonical semantics but do not become semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: archive filename used as semantic identity
package silently includes active semantics absent from manifest
packaging changes source_role or semantic ownership
same package identity refers to incompatible semantic snapshots

references.purpose: Package membership derives from explicit repository inventory.
